transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (705x909) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 30/01/2013 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name '130130'. The bottom of the window (notes box) is cropped off; the chart itself is complete down to 0 cm. Height axis uniform here: 2.7 px/cm, 200 cm at y300, 0 at y840. Boundaries 167/133/132/114/113/49/32/27/0 from bar edges (each bar's top border row falls on an integer cm) and the H-column leader lines; the two SH layers are ~1 cm gaps between bars (no bar drawn). Table rows mapped one-to-one to the drawn layers. Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F, (none), 1F- (7 px short of 1F), (none), 1F+ (13 px past 1F), P, P- (14 px short of P), P-; R-column icons agree. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline); the surface marker reads -4.1 = printed Surface Temp. Markers every 10 cm to 100 cm, then every 20 cm (none drawn at 90/70/50/30/10); markers at 80-0 cm lie inside the hatched bars (+-0.1-0.2 C); the 0 cm marker is half hidden under the bottom border. 157 cm point read at 156.8.
